title: InsightViz render path: Query → InsightViz → InsightVizDisplay → per-type component
answers: How does InsightViz render an insight?
Where does the chart component for a display type get chosen?
Where is the chart type control rendered?
body:
- frontend/src/queries/Query/Query.tsx renders <InsightViz> for an InsightVizNode.
- frontend/src/queries/nodes/InsightViz/InsightViz.tsx:InsightViz builds insightProps + dataNodeLogicProps, uses useAttachedLogic for dataNodeLogic/insightLogic/insightDataLogic/insightVizDataLogic, wraps in nested BindLogic, renders EditorFilters + InsightVizDisplay.
- InsightVizDisplay.tsx: picks empty state first (order matters), then switches on activeView: TRENDS/STICKINESS/LIFECYCLE→TrendInsight, FUNNELS→Funnel, RETENTION→RetentionContainer, PATHS→Paths, JOURNEYS→Journeys, WEB_ANALYTICS→WebAnalyticsInsight.
- products/product_analytics/frontend/insights/trends/Trends.tsx:TrendInsight dispatches on ChartDisplayType (bar/table/BoldNumber/Metric/WorldMap/RegionMap lazy via lazyWithRetry/CalendarHeatmap/BoxPlot/SlopeGraph; pie/line default).
- Chart type control: InsightVizDisplay passes <ChartAlternatives> into InsightDisplayConfig's chartTypeControl slot.
- Display metadata: InsightViz/displayTypes.ts, insightDisplayOptions.tsx.
says: How does the system render an insight's visualization chart on the screen?
Where does the code decide which chart component to display for a type?
How does switching visualization types cause the right chart to render?
Which part renders the actual chart for trends, funnels, and other types?

search: InsightViz render path flows Query → InsightViz → InsightVizDisplay → per-type component (TrendInsight/Funnel/Retention/Paths/Journeys/WebAnalyticsInsight). InsightViz builds insightProps, attaches dataNodeLogic and keyed logics via useAttachedLogic, renders EditorFilters + InsightVizDisplay. InsightVizDisplay checks empty state first, then switches on activeView; TrendInsight further dispatches on ChartDisplayType (bar/table/line/pie/BoldNumber/WorldMap via lazyWithRetry). Chart type control uses ChartAlternatives in InsightDisplayConfig.chartTypeControl slot. Applies to adding new insight types, modifying display logic, and changing chart rendering pipelines.
